function: Symbol-level constructive-interference precoding: SLE-Net computes the MU-MISO downlink precoding matrix per symbol slot by unfolding the extrapolation algorithm (pp. 2, 8).
system: Downlink MU-MISO, Mt transmit antennas (ULA) serving K single-antenna users, Mt=K=8 or 12 in BER plots; no RIS; frequency band not stated (pp. 3, 10).
method: Deep-unfolded network SLE-Net: R layers with learnable scalars b_r and vectors tau_r, trained unsupervised with Adam on loss -mean(min output) (pp. 8-9).
data_channel: Custom simulated clustered channel with Markov-process AoDs and auto-regressive path gains; QPSK, 8PSK, 16QAM; 100 blocks of 8000 symbol slots; no dataset described (pp. 3, 10).
test_conditions: Training scenario not stated; tests at Mt=K=8 and 12, QPSK/8PSK/16QAM, SNR sweep and iteration counts; no new-condition test reported (pp. 8, 10-12).
baselines: Non-learned: ZF, optimization-based CI-OPT, iterative closed-form CI-CF-PSK and CI-CF-QAM, plus own SLE-CF and SLE-Sub variants; no learned baseline (p. 10).
metrics: BER versus SNR, BER versus maximum iterations, execution time per channel realization, and FLOPs count (Table I) (pp. 10-12).
complexity: Closed-form counts of multiplications/additions, e.g. SLE-Net Onet=(9Ns+3)K^3+..., FLOPs table for 4x4 to 20x20 (7.08e7 at 8x8), execution time (pp. 10-11).
q1_support: p. 3: "a limited number of scattering clusters between the transmitter and each receiver"; custom ULA path model with Markov-process AoDs, no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, COST 2100, or measured data.
q2_support: p. 8: "minimized by the adaptive moment estimation (ADAM) algorithm in [40] until the network converges"; training data and scenario are never described, and pp. 10-12 sweep SNR, Mt=K, modulation, iterations with no train/test mismatch stated.
q3_support: p. 10: ZF, CI-OPT, CI-CF-PSK are non-learned and "SLE-Net: deep unfolding method based on SLE" is the proposed one; the earlier learned CI-NN [26] (p. 2) is not compared.
q4_support: p. 10: "Onet = Oe + Od + On" given as a polynomial in K, Ns, R (multiplications and additions); p. 11: "TABLE I: The number of FLOPS" and Fig. 8 execution time.
q5_support: p. 10: "Our simulation environment utilizes PyTorch version 1.13.1"; no code or data link, and the channel is simulated, not a public dataset.
notes: PDF is the arXiv preprint v1 (arXiv:2405.16446, 26 May 2024), no DOI printed; topic and IEEE TWC format are consistent. Included under the deep-unfolding rule: SLE-Net has trained parameters b_r and tau_r (p. 8). The main SLE-CF and SLE-Sub algorithms are closed-form, not learned. Area 3: symbol-level precoder at the base station. Only non-learned baselines, so q3=0.
